research.facts:
Norris Wins 2026 Hungarian Grand Prix
**Sources:**
- Formula1.com: "Norris beats Verstappen and Antonelli to victory in dramatic Hungarian GP"
- Motorsport Week: "F1 2026 Hungarian Grand Prix - Race Results"
- ESPN: "Lando Norris takes first victory of the season in upgraded McLaren at Hungarian Grand Prix"
- autoracing1.com: "Formula 1 News: Norris eases to 2026 Hungarian GP win"
- RacingNews365: "2026 F1 Hungarian Grand Prix - Budapest results"
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Lando Norris won the 2026 Hungarian Grand Prix [Formula1.com, multiple sources]
- Podium: Norris (McLaren) 1st, Verstappen (Red Bull) 2nd, Antonelli (Mercedes) 3rd [Formula1.com, RacingNews365]
- Norris finished approximately 15 seconds ahead of Verstappen [ESPN]
- Oscar Piastri (McLaren) took the lead at the start but retired during the race [Formula1.com]
- Lewis Hamilton crossed the line in fourth but was demoted to fifth due to a five-second time penalty for speeding in the pit lane [Formula1.com]
- Charles Leclerc was promoted to fourth as a result of Hamilton's penalty [Formula1.com]
- This was Norris's first race win of the 2026 season as reigning world champion [Formula1.com, ESPN]
- Norris had taken pole position (1:17.207) — McLaren's first 2026 pole, ending Mercedes' 10-race pole streak [from July 26 pipeline]
**Freshness justification:** Race completed July 27 2026; first race win of Norris's championship defence; dramatic result with Piastri DNF.

research.facts:
Verstappen Exit Clause Now Active
**Sources:**
- RacingNews365: "Max Verstappen can now trigger exit clause to potentially leave Red Bull"
- ESPN: "Verstappen refuses to commit to Red Bull past 2026 amid growing McLaren exit rumours"
- Planet F1: "Max Verstappen McLaren move: Red Bull exit clause nears as contract talks advance"
- Sportbible: "Max Verstappen in closing stages of huge F1 move"
- Autosport: "Red Bull confirms Lambiase exit for F1 2028"
- Formula1.com: "What does Lambiase's Red Bull exit mean for Verstappen"
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Verstappen's contract allows him to leave Red Bull in 2027 if outside top two in championship at summer break [RacingNews365, ESPN]
- Verstappen finished sixth in the championship at the summer break — well outside the top two [multiple standings sources]
- Exit clause is therefore now active [RacingNews365]
- Lambiase (Verstappen's race engineer) confirmed leaving Red Bull for McLaren in 2028 as Chief Racing Officer [Autosport]
- Verstappen refused to commit to Red Bull past 2026 when asked directly [ESPN]
- Verstappen quote: "There's nothing to say" (when asked about his future) [ESPN]
- Red Bull tried to buy out exit clause in June talks; Verstappen refused [Planet F1]
**Facts (MEDIUM confidence):**
- McLaren move described as in "closing stages" (Sportbible) — not independently confirmed with exact timeline
**Freshness justification:** Exit clause becomes active at summer break; Hungary was last race before break; this is the breaking window.
